$comment: GOLDEN FACTS read from the source document, NOT from FinSight output.
A SCANNED filing: consolidated results, INR crore, five columns (three quarters,
two years; the quarter and year to 31.03.2026 share an end date). Unseparated
figures; the filer's OCR layer damages some ('p.44)' for (1.44)). Every figure read
from the render; every subtotal re-added.
Line 3 is profit before tax, regulatory deferral balances AND the share of joint
ventures; line 5 adds that share (the statement's PBT). Line 7 is a qualified profit
after tax (before regulatory deferral movements; metric null); line 9 is profit.
OCI item (ii) has TWO parts with no total, so neither part is the income tax on
items not reclassified (metric null); a tax line labelled '(a) Net actuarial
gains/(losses)...' names the tax on that item, not the item. The year column of
(i)(c) prints a dash while the quarters print figures -- as printed.

Phase 22: every row carries 'metric', the canonical key its printed label names, decided by reading the label in its statement (null: the taxonomy has no key for the line); 'metric_alt' lists keys that name the same measure. The scorer checks the key, not only the printed label.

transcription.method: read by eye from the render; positions from the filer's OCR layer
transcription.verified_against: page render at 170-220 dpi and the statement's own totals
